"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, matching the report's page size."""

import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")
COVER = Path("cover.pdf")


def main() -> None:
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Missing input file: {SRC}")

    reader = PdfReader(str(SRC))
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        raise SystemExit("Input PDF has no pages.")

    # Use the first page's dimensions so the cover matches the report.
    mb = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mb.width)
    height = float(mb.height)

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    c = canvas.Canvas(str(COVER), pagesize=(width, height))

    # Title (centered, bold)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    title_width = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height * 0.55, title)

    # Date (centered, regular weight, below the title)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    date_width = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height * 0.45, date_str)

    c.save()

    cover_reader = PdfReader(str(COVER))
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    print(
        f"Created {OUT}: 1 cover page + {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) "
        f"= {len(reader.pages) + 1} pages total."
    )
    print(f"Cover title: {title!r}  Date: {date_str!r}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, matching the report's page size.

Uses only pypdf (for reading the source size and merging) and builds the
cover page as a minimal hand-written PDF (standard Helvetica Type1 font),
so no reportlab/fpdf dependency is required.
"""

import datetime
import sys
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")

# Standard Helvetica glyph widths (1/1000 em) for ASCII 32..126.
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = [
    278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278,
    556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556,
    1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833, 722, 778,
    667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278, 278, 278, 469, 556,
    333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833, 556, 556,
    556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500, 334, 260, 334, 584,
]


def text_width(text: str, font_size: float) -> float:
    """Approximate Helvetica text width in points."""
    total = 0.0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 32 <= code <= 126:
            total += HELVETICA_WIDTHS[code - 32]
        else:
            total += 556  # fallback width
    return total * font_size / 1000.0


def esc_text(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(width: float, height: float, title: str, date_str: str) -> bytes:
    """Construct a one-page PDF with centered title and date."""
    title_size = 28.0
    date_size = 16.0

    x1 = (width - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    y1 = height * 0.55
    x2 = (width - text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0
    y2 = height * 0.45

    content = (
        f"BT\n/F1 {title_size:g} Tf\n{x1:.2f} {y1:.2f} Td\n"
        f"({esc_text(title)}) Tj\nET\n"
        f"BT\n/F1 {date_size:g} Tf\n{x2:.2f} {y2:.2f} Td\n"
        f"({esc_text(date_str)}) Tj\nET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = {
        1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        2: b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        3: (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {width:.2f} {height:.2f}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
        ).encode("latin-1"),
        4: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        5: (
            f"<< /Length {len(content)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1")
            + content
            + b"\nendstream"
        ),
    }

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
        out += objects[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = len(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in sorted(objects):
        out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    return bytes(out)


def main() -> None:
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Missing input file: {SRC}")

    reader = PdfReader(str(SRC))
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        raise SystemExit("Input PDF has no pages.")

    mb = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mb.width)
    height = float(mb.height)

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf(width, height, title, date_str)

    cover_reader = PdfReader(BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    print(
        f"Created {OUT}: 1 cover page + {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) "
        f"= {len(reader.pages) + 1} pages total."
    )
    print(f"Cover title: {title!r}  Date: {date_str!r}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, matching the report's page size."""

import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")
COVER = Path("cover.pdf")


def main() -> None:
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Missing input file: {SRC}")

    reader = PdfReader(str(SRC))
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        raise SystemExit("Input PDF has no pages.")

    # Use the first page's dimensions so the cover matches the report.
    mb = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mb.width)
    height = float(mb.height)

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    c = canvas.Canvas(str(COVER), pagesize=(width, height))

    # Title (centered, bold)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    title_width = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height * 0.55, title)

    # Date (centered, regular weight, below the title)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    date_width = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height * 0.45, date_str)

    c.save()

    cover_reader = PdfReader(str(COVER))
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    print(
        f"Created {OUT}: 1 cover page + {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) "
        f"= {len(reader.pages) + 1} pages total."
    )
    print(f"Cover title: {title!r}  Date: {date_str!r}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, matching the report's page size.

Uses only pypdf (for reading the source size and merging) and builds the
cover page as a minimal hand-written PDF (standard Helvetica Type1 font),
so no reportlab/fpdf dependency is required.
"""

import datetime
import sys
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")

# Standard Helvetica glyph widths (1/1000 em) for ASCII 32..126.
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = [
    278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278,
    556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556,
    1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833, 722, 778,
    667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278, 278, 278, 469, 556,
    333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833, 556, 556,
    556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500, 334, 260, 334, 584,
]


def text_width(text: str, font_size: float) -> float:
    """Approximate Helvetica text width in points."""
    total = 0.0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 32 <= code <= 126:
            total += HELVETICA_WIDTHS[code - 32]
        else:
            total += 556  # fallback width
    return total * font_size / 1000.0


def esc_text(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(width: float, height: float, title: str, date_str: str) -> bytes:
    """Construct a one-page PDF with centered title and date."""
    title_size = 28.0
    date_size = 16.0

    x1 = (width - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    y1 = height * 0.55
    x2 = (width - text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0
    y2 = height * 0.45

    content = (
        f"BT\n/F1 {title_size:g} Tf\n{x1:.2f} {y1:.2f} Td\n"
        f"({esc_text(title)}) Tj\nET\n"
        f"BT\n/F1 {date_size:g} Tf\n{x2:.2f} {y2:.2f} Td\n"
        f"({esc_text(date_str)}) Tj\nET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = {
        1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        2: b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        3: (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {width:.2f} {height:.2f}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
        ).encode("latin-1"),
        4: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        5: (
            f"<< /Length {len(content)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1")
            + content
            + b"\nendstream"
        ),
    }

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
        out += objects[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = len(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in sorted(objects):
        out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    return bytes(out)


def main() -> None:
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Missing input file: {SRC}")

    reader = PdfReader(str(SRC))
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        raise SystemExit("Input PDF has no pages.")

    mb = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mb.width)
    height = float(mb.height)

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf(width, height, title, date_str)

    cover_reader = PdfReader(BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    print(
        f"Created {OUT}: 1 cover page + {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) "
        f"= {len(reader.pages) + 1} pages total."
    )
    print(f"Cover title: {title!r}  Date: {date_str!r}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
